name.value: Best Western Plus Chateau Fort St. John

description.value: The Best Western Plus Chateau Fort St. John is a modern, full-service hotel positioned directly on Alaska Highway 97, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists travelling the iconic highway corridor through northeast BC. The property offers kitchenette-equipped rooms and a complimentary full hot breakfast, giving touring cyclists options for self-catering and a hot start to the day. Fort St. John bills itself as the 'Energetic City' and serves as the main service hub for the Peace Country, so most supplies and services a cyclist might need are close at hand.
